versions.content: The function Fr_AllSlots shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Invoke the CC CHI command ‘ALL_SLOTS’, which requests a switch from key slot only mode to all slots transmission mode at the beginning of the next communication cycle. 2. Return E_OK.
